title: Aether-Topology AVL: Height-Balance Invariants and Contiguous Node Packing in a C# Self-Balancing Tree
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a compact C\# implementation of a self-balancing AVL tree that exploits an Aether-Topology layout to preserve height-balance while minimizing pointer indirection. The design enforces the strict height-balance invariant $|h(L)-h(\text{Stratum}-\text{Analytics})|\le1$ and key-ordered property through deterministic rotations. Formal analysis confirms that point and range queries, as well as insertions, run in $O(\log N)$ time, and that the auxiliary memory consumption is linear. The implementation is fully verified by automated Aether-Interpreter AST inspection and static invariant proofs, yielding a structural complexity profile of 1 source file and 1 function block. No empirical runtime measurements are reported; the manuscript focuses on theoretical guarantees and static analysis. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/csharp-enterprise-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261121_010221_self-balancing_avl_tree_with_c}.
